bazar.title: Prompt Bazar
bazar.imageAlt: Al-Khwarizmi with his astrolabe in the bazar, the guide of Prompt Bazar
bazar.lede: A private AI filmmaking library and production workspace: a searchable memory of what works in generative video, built for models like Seedance and Kling.

points.text: splits a prompt into subject, action, camera, environment, light, timing and constraints, and flags what is missing.
keeps scripts, shots and continuity, so a run of AI shots holds the same characters, props and screen direction.
People log whether they tried a prompt, how it turned out, and on which model.
Pahlewan AI, MCP Abad, Comfy Library, Higgsfield Open Films and AI Radar.

bazar.footnote: React · TypeScript · Cloudflare Workers · D1 · R2

siavash.title: Siavash
siavash.lede: A hunting game painted like a Shahnameh manuscript. Young Siavash learns the bow from Rostam, reads the wind to bring down the stag, and meets Azhdaha, the Serpent of the Falls.
